wish: someone should make a chess variant where a hidden random piece is the king
spec:
Two-player pass-and-play chess where each side secretly has one of its 16 pieces crowned as the king.
Tap a piece then a square to move; show my king outlines your own secret king; capture the opponent's hidden king to win and both are revealed.
No check, castling or en passant; pawns promote to queen; one device, no engine.
notes: Pass-and-play on one device; the player to move taps show my king to see their own secret king.
